items.reason: The first line names only the Task set; the Runtime path and binding kind appear on later lines.
The header prints for whole-set runs both inside and outside the bound checkout.
The comparison uses checkout roots, so an invocation from a subdirectory incorrectly omits the invoked-from line.
A new Default binding adds the required announcement.
The old conditional bound-checkout line is removed.
A single-task HITL target returns through its gate before the current-checkout line prints.
Successful task completion prints one green done line.
The commit SHA or verified no-op detail prints beneath the done line.
The old Completed task line is replaced without adding a second success result.
Exhausted task failures retain Failed state and print one red failed line.
Provider exhaustion prints one red out-of-agents result and leaves the task Open.
Quota pause prints the yellow result with the selected preset.
An interrupted attempt prints the yellow interrupted result.
Blocked and Deferred remain set-level reports; executed tasks retain their own results.
Attempt failure, breakdown, and exhausted-walk output remain intact.
The shared output formatter preserves complete lines without ANSI escapes when redirected.
The shared formatter applies terminal color and respects NO_COLOR.
The new output functions add no Work journal writes.

scores.rationale: Clear, small changes with useful tests, but header placement and directory edge cases remain; tests miss subdirectory and single-task HITL paths.
